measurementSemantics.listeners: Test-instrumented registrations whose EventTarget is the global/document target or a currently connected DOM node. Detached and non-DOM targets are retained only as diagnostic counts because garbage collection timing is non-deterministic.
measurementSemantics.workers: Playwright page worker lifecycle events; no Worker constructor monkey-patching.
measurementSemantics.heap: Browser-exposed JavaScript heap only when available; not process RSS, GPU memory, or driver VRAM.
measurementSemantics.gpuResources: First-party executable WebGL resource inventory where the Living renderer exposes it; not physical GPU memory.
